comparison.objective: Open a flashlight and tip its battery into a picking bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual threaded disassembly followed by controlled tipping and placement of three rigid parts.
comparison.success_condition: Cap unscrewed and placed, battery contained in box, flashlight placed outside it, all still for 1 s; forced removal or loss fails.
comparison.reason: It shares controlled pouring of one object into a receptacle, but has no selective screen, bridging, retained population, or recovery-fraction control. No material rubric detail is missing.
